representative_scale.scale_policy: One fixed scale from brief. No search, step doubling or toy extrapolation.

outputs.energy_series_reason: Full series sampled internally, not saved by provided driver.

timing_scope.ensemble: time.perf_counter around entire sequential replica loop; includes context creation, initial positions/velocities, integration, energy sampling, Python overhead and context destruction.
timing_scope.excluded: Imports, argument parsing, input loading and system construction before timer; final JSON writing and stdout after timer.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context initialization and velocity assignment; includes stepping and energy retrieval, excludes context destruction.
timing_scope.concurrent_comparison: Same eight replicas and all work completed on same one GPU. End-to-end time must include corresponding initialization and completion costs; separate-process orchestration is not supplied in brief.
timing_scope.kernel_compilation: Not explicitly warmed outside ensemble timer; includes any context/first-step compilation occurring inside loop.
timing_scope.upstream_difference: Published benchmark.py adaptively chooses step counts for fixed-time throughput, warming kernels first. Do not invoke its adaptive workload as representative fixed-work run.

scoring_interface.primary: Read ensemble.json total_wall_s, require all eight replica records with 25000 steps and seeds 1000-1007.
scoring_interface.scientific_comparison: Compare per-replica final and mean potential energies under matched configuration; full-series criterion requires additional output.
scoring_interface.acceptance_tolerance_reason: No published numerical energy tolerance; documented force determinism is not a verified full-trajectory acceptance bound.
scoring_interface.reference_scope: Published throughput observation is fixed-time context only; cannot validate fixed-work energy outcomes.

budget_evidence.runtime_expectation: Brief estimates about one minute for H100 ensemble and a few minutes for slower GPUs, unverified.
budget_evidence.reason: No CUDA reproduction, context-compilation measurement or installation timing. Fixed scale retained; no guaranteed completion time claimed.

method_command_reason: Concurrent fixed-work driver and command are not supplied; no command invented. MPS hypothesis is study method, not completed implementation.
